text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, that's pretty awesome, Yukino Bijin.
I kinda just assumed you were all airheaded and fluffy.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Well, but come to think of it,
she is an Oaks Umamusume after all.
She's just plain strong.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijiiin!
Keep doing your best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Thank ye so much~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
were you watching?
choice_data_list: You got a huge round of applause out there.
You got so much applause, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
everyone was so warm and kind.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, long as I can run in a way I'm truly proud of, everything'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...I think I was able to run
real proud and mighty today!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Maybe it's because you helped take the pressure off my shoulders, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All that unnecessary tension was gone, and I felt like I could really run like myself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I think... I might actually kinda like
the way I am today."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~
choice_data_list: Keep that momentum going for the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
—Yukino-chan was amazing.
It felt different from the usual idol vibe I'd heard about, though.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she was just working hard like any other Umamusume.
Though that goes for everyone running in the races, really...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Honestly, with a name like "Angel of Snow,"
I was expecting some next-level, totally overwhelming charisma!
...Or something like that, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's getting a bit too hyped up, huh.
I wonder if I'll ever go watch again—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Alright.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "I'm gonna run cool as hell at the Shuka Sho, no doubt about it...!"
